protocol.generator: Upstream make_weights; family independently equiprobable independent/paired; fresh lists
protocol.target_rule: Uniform on integer [round(.30 sum(w)),round(.70 sum(w))] conditional on reachable residues mod 8,10,16,32
protocol.outer_interval: 512 random witnessed subsets lower; min(1, product_j(c_j+1)/eligible_target_count) upper
baselines: degree-2 ridge on density proxy, unique fraction, and analytic upper
protocol.calibration: Two one-sided gap-normalized scores; rank ceil((m+1)*(1-alpha/2)); no model tuning on calibration/test
protocol.primary_evaluation: All fresh n16 test lists; empirical coverage, exact binomial CI, mean per-list fractional shrinkage, width, timing
diagnostics: top 20% predicted fractional shrinkage; diagnostic, no conditional guarantee
protocol.independent_label_checks: 30 small brute-force cases; first 12 n16 test labels independently checked with integer bitset DP
protocol.limits: Synthetic distribution; marginal statistical coverage only; no per-instance deterministic refinement; training/calibration labels are exact and costed

regression.timing_note: Regression reuses stored witnessed counts; timings exclude their original construction. Full-collision method is an evaluation oracle.

notes: Original statistical measurements and frozen deterministic sources preserved.
Percent width removed is the mean per-list fractional reduction unless explicitly stated otherwise.
Bitset timing uses 149 feasible cases; 11 exceeded the predeclared bit cap.
Single timing per method/list; memory profiled separately on eight prespecified lists.
